must.title: Migration Performance Preservation
must.description: Critical user flows across app, build-logic, chat, common must complete within 20% of pre-migration latency on the same Android device / API level combination throughout the phased Compose + StateFlow + Hilt migration. Regressions halt phase promotion until resolved.
must.metric: p95 interactive latency per critical flow <= 1.2x legacy baseline, measured on the same device matrix.
acceptance_criteria: Pre-migration p95 latency baseline captured on reference device matrix before cutover begins.
Post-migration p95 measured per release candidate; threshold breach blocks phase promotion.
Device-matrix evidence attached to the release checklist.
must.verification: Android device lab replay of critical flows pre- and post-migration; p95 delta report gated in CI.

available_skills.name: Kotlin Modernization Skill Pack
available_skills.description: Analysis for Kotlin codebases — both server-side (Kotlin/JVM with Spring Boot, Ktor, or Micronaut) and Android (Android Gradle Plugin apps/libraries with Compose, Hilt/Koin, Room, Retrofit, Navigation, Coroutines/Flow).
analysis_focus: module topology and Gradle source-set layout (server vs Android)
Kotlin nuance inventory: null-safety, sealed hierarchies, data classes, delegation, DSLs
structured concurrency map: suspend functions, Flow producers/consumers, Dispatchers, runBlocking
framework surface: Spring Boot / Ktor / Micronaut on server, Activity/Fragment/Compose on Android
DI topology: Hilt/Dagger components, Koin modules, manual wiring
persistence: Room/SQLDelight on Android, JPA/Exposed/SQLDelight on server
networking: Retrofit interfaces, OkHttp interceptors, Ktor client blocks
architectural seam identification and dead-module detection
